This stream uses http:// and this site uses https://; browsers block it, so it will not play.

Which URL do I use?

Use the address of the audio stream itself, not your station's website. It often ends in a mount point or a file name, such as /stream, /live, or /radio.mp3.

Icecast: open the server's status page (for example, http://example.com:8000/) and copy your mount point's URL.

Shoutcast: version 1 servers need /; after the port (for example, http://example.com:8000/;). Version 2 servers use /stream or /;.

AzuraCast: copy a mount point URL from the Streams list on the station's Profile page. Centova Cast and other control panels: copy the stream address from the Listen or Tune in links.

Not sure? Paste the playlist link of your Listen button (.pls or .m3u) or the address of your server's page, and click Test Stream. It suggests the URL to use.


The player replaces this whole page, so an empty page works best. Each page can be used by only one radio station.



An MP3 that plays once before the live stream, the first time a listener presses Play. It cannot be paused or skipped.

Shows the song that is playing below the station name, if your streaming server provides it (Icecast, some hosting providers, or HLS streams with ID3 tags). On some servers, each song lookup counts as one more listener.
